As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

jobs.occupation: Communications and Media Relations Manager M/W/X
jobs.description:
About the position 
The Communications and Media Relations Manager leads ECF's communications and visibility, while also supporting EuroVelo and Velo-city brands, towards EU institutions, the media, project partners and international stakeholders.  

You will report to the CEO, manage the Communications team, and work closely with the other teams across ECF to ensure that our messages are clear and that the voice of cyclists is heard and acted upon by policy- and decision-makers in Brussels, across Europe and beyond. 

• Strategy & Planning 
• Develop, implement and evaluate the annual communications and media relations plan, aligning activities with ECF's organisational priorities and strategic objectives 
• Ensure consistency of messaging across all channels and audiences 
• Manage and allocate team resources according to priorities (currently 2.5 FTE) 
• Coordinate ECF's visibility at key conferences and events, monitor speaking engagements and booth preparations where applicable 
• Lead on the drafting, design and publication of the ECF Annual Report.  
      2. Content Creation & Editorial Management 

• Oversee the creation of high-quality content (news, articles, speeches, newsletters, reports) based on ECF advocacy priorities and knowledge products 
• Develop core messaging and campaigns to support our advocacy and fundraising efforts 
• Plan and create content (written and visual) for ECF's audiences, including the website, newsletters, social media, and press 
• Oversee communications for EU-funded projects and contribute to relevant deliverables and reporting 
       3. Media Relations 

• Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, media outlets, and opinion leaders 
• Draft and distribute press releases, media pitches, and statements 
• Coordinate media interviews, briefings, and press events 
• Monitor media coverage and manage reputational issues and crisis communications when needed 
       4. Digital & Internal Communications 

• Manage ECF's website, mailing system and digital communication channels (CMS, CRM, Brevo, newsletters, press releases, LinkedIn, Instagram, Bluesky)  
• Develop a digital communications strategy to ensure high engagement and grow ECF's audience 
• Support all ECF teams with key messages, talking points, and presentations 
 
 Who are we looking for? 
Background: 

• A degree in a relevant field and/or relevant professional qualifications in communications or journalism  
• At least 5 years' experience in a communications role, e.g. in advocacy, public administration, PR consultancy or similar, with a proven track record 
• Experience in advocacy, campaigning and media relations  
• Experience managing a team 
• 
Experience working in an international and/or membership-based organisation is a plus. 

 

Competencies, skills and attributes: 

• Highly motivated, open-minded, proactive and results-oriented  
• A team player who works well in diverse teams, and is an effective networker 
• Ability to plan and structure communications activities to maximise their impact  
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (near-native proficiency) 
• Design and social media skills and ability to explore different formats for different audiences and objectives (visuals, videos and graphics) 
Must have at recruitment 

• Proven experience in communications and media relations 
• Experience in advocacy communications and/or campaigning 
• Excellent writing and editing skills 
• Strong command of English.  What we offer 
ECF offers an employment package in line with similar non-governmental organizations based in Brussels, including a gross monthly salary of €4,200- €4,800, depending on relevant experience. Benefits include flexible working hours, up to 20 legal and 10 extra-legal vacation days (pro rata), public transport and cycling allowances, a work-from-home allowance, lunch vouchers, eco-cheques and an extra-legal pension scheme.
